title: BREAKING: Jose Enrique Huerta Jr. arrested on alleged third-degree felony drug charge
excerpt: BREAKING: Jose Enrique Huerta Jr. arrested on alleged third-degree felony drug charge
content:
LAREDO, Texas — Jose Enrique Huerta Jr. was arrested Wednesday at 2:43 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony drug charge, according to public booking records.

Huerta is charged with possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 2, in an amount of 1 gram or more but less than 4 grams. The charge is a third-degree felony under Texas law. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

His listed city is Laredo, Texas 78040. The arresting agency was the Laredo Police Department.

All charges are allegations. Huerta is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
